segments.an6.38:1.1: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an6.38:1.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.38:1.5: “Māhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.
segments.an6.38:1.6: Kathañhi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto, sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati –
segments.an6.38:2.5: “Yaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, ārabbhadhātuyā sati ārabbhavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro ayaṃ parakāro”.
segments.an6.38:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, atthi nikkamadhātu … pe … atthi parakkamadhātu … atthi thāmadhātu … atthi ṭhitidhātu … atthi upakkamadhātū”ti?
segments.an6.38:3.9: “Yaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, upakkamadhātuyā sati upakkamavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro ayaṃ parakāro”.
segments.an6.38:4.1: “Māhaṃ, brāhmaṇa [taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa māhaṃ (ka.)], evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.
segments.an6.38:4.2: Kathañhi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati –
segments.an6.38:5.1: “Abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti!

lines: Aṭṭhame addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vāti akkhīni ummīletvā mā addasaṃ, asukasmiṃ nāma ṭhāne vasatīti mā assosiṃ, kathentassa vā vacanaṃ mā assosiṃ.
Sabbaṃ cetaṃ tena tenākārena pavattassa vīriyasseva nāmaṃ.
38-41. Aṭṭhame kusalakiriyāya ādiārambhabhāvena pavattavīriyaṃ ṭhitasabhāvatāya sabhāvadhāraṇaṭṭhena dhātūti vuttanti āha –
Laddhāsevanaṃ vīriyaṃ balappattaṃ hutvā paṭipakkhe vidhamatīti āha “nikkamadhātūti kosajjato nikkhamanasabhāvaṃ vīriyan”ti.
Parakkamanasabhāvoti adhimattatarānaṃ paṭipakkhadhammānaṃ vidhamanasamatthatāya paṭupaṭutarabhāvena paraṃ paraṃ ṭhānaṃ akkamanasabhāvo.
Mukhaṃ vikkhāletvāti tesaṃyeva mukhaṃ vikkhāletvā, attanāva mukhodakaṃ datvāti adhippāyo.
